STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE - SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and
mixing vessels
Document: SOP-07 Solvent cleaning of dispersers and mixing vessels
Revision: Rev 7, effective 18/05/2015.
Steps
1. Drain residual product into recovery drum.
2. Bond and earth vessel and solvent drum before transfer (clamps at solvent station).
3. Rinse with 40 L acetone, circulate 10 min, drain to waste solvent.
4. Second rinse with 20 L fresh acetone, drain.
5. Wipe agitator shaft and blades with xylene-soaked rag.
6. Before vessel entry: forced ventilation 15 min, O2/LEL test, entry permit.
7. Leave lid open overnight.
8. Wait at least 60 min before charging next batch.
9. Record cleaning in vessel logbook and sign.
Change note
Wait before next charge restored to 60 min (CR-2015-004 cancels CR-2014-011).
